description: Compare a run of like slides shape by shape: where name, box, text size, colour, font, text layout (alignment, spacing, bullets, anchor, insets, autofit), fill, outline, table rows, widths or borders differ from the majority or a reference; near-misses, layout and tables with a fix. Measures only.

reference.description: Expected values: fixes go toward it.

slides.description: Slide numbers from 1, or ids (s:256, $ref); at least two (one with reference).

name: ppt_compare_slides
